sources.entry: Build a Todo List with Django and Test-Driven Development

summary.title: Obey the Testing Goat!
summary.one_liner: Learn test-driven development for web applications with Python, Selenium, Django and JavaScript through the free, CC-licensed companion book by Harry Percival.
keywords: django unit tests speed up sqlite
how to learn tdd with django
takeaways: The site hosts Harry Percival's book on test-driven development for web programming using Python, Selenium, Django and JavaScript.
The full book is available free online under a Creative Commons licence, and also for purchase from O'Reilly and retailers.
A third edition is in progress, updated for the latest Django and Python, with deployment chapters rewritten to use Docker and Ansible.
The blog covers related topics such as pytest fixtures, speeding up Django tests, and software architecture patterns.
summary.summary: This is the homepage for Harry Percival's book on test-driven development for web programming, published by O'Reilly, with the full text available free online under a CC licence. The page links to purchase options, a read-online option, and a blog with posts on editions, Python/Django upgrades, pytest patterns, and architecture. It also lists TDD resources and an older Django TDD tutorial that the author says needs updating. The listing places it as a web-application project-based tutorial that builds a Todo list with Django and TDD.
